products.name: Deepgram
products.note: Speech recognition API; real-time transcription; model customization; on-prem option

profile_text.body:
Deepgram is a voice AI company that provides speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice agent APIs aimed at enterprise customers. The company describes itself as "the industry's voice AI leader" and positions its platform around real-time performance, accuracy, and scale. Rather than requiring customers to assemble separate components, Deepgram unifies speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and LLM orchestration into a single API, which it says reduces complexity, latency, and cost.

Deepgram's core product is a speech recognition API offering real-time transcription, model customization, and an on-premises deployment option. The company has also launched Flux TTS, which it describes as the first voice model that thinks before it speaks, holding tone, expression, and continuity across an entire conversation. Flux TTS was made available free through September 12th, with up to 45 concurrent streaming connections in the US and 5 in the EU and Australia. Deepgram has also announced an integration with Amazon Connect.

The site's held facts confirm Deepgram maintains a tracked presence on theworldofai.org under the Voice and Audio category. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the current held facts.
